rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a good-quality day-5 blastocyst with visible ICM, cohesive TE, and somewhat thinned zona; appropriately notes limits of a single static image. Minor overcalling of TE/expansion crispness given the image is somewhat blurry/collapsed.
Thoroughly integrates age, embryo grade, endometriosis, BMI, ovarian reserve, prior biochemical pregnancy, sperm quality, endometrial thickness, and cohort size into prognosis and transfer planning.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately tempered by endometriosis and untested status despite strong morphology and favorable age.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including single embryo transfer and avoiding unsupported add-ons; minor uncertainty around strength of claims for prolonged suppression in endometriosis without more specifics.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support adherence, when to investigate cavity/receptivity issues, and selective discussion of PGT-A and embryo banking.
